title: WHAT WE DO
description: When your **personal safety or peace of mind is at risk**, you need a **trusted security and investigative team** that will work relentlessly on your behalf. Our firm specializes in safeguarding our clients, providing **clarity, confidence and discreet support** when you need it most.

cards.title: Private Investigation
cards.description: Confidential matrimonial, pre-matrimonial and personal enquiries across Kolkata and West Bengal, with the evidence behind every finding.

cards.title: Security Services
cards.description: Vetted, trained guards and supervisors for societies, offices, warehouses and events — plus the site audit that says what you actually need.

cards.title: Corporate Investigation & Risk
cards.description: Due diligence, employee and vendor verification, and internal fraud enquiries that let a business decide on evidence rather than instinct.

cards.title: NRI Services
cards.description: On-ground checks in India for non-resident Indians — matrimonial, property and tenant verification, and welfare visits to family.

cards.title: Forensic Investigation
cards.description: Questioned documents, handwriting and signature comparison, and digital evidence — handled so the method stands up to review.
